measures.name: m_paid_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_valid_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_cancelled_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_refund_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_partial_refund_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_full_refund_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > 0 AND refund_cents = paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_payment_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_refund_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_net_sales_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_gross_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_discount_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_buyer_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END

measures.name: m_refund_buyer_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END

measures.name: m_selling_store_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN store_id END

measures.name: m_valid_order_items
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.label: 创建订单数
metrics.description: 按下单日期统计全部订单，每个订单号一次，包含取消单。

metrics.name: paid_order_count
metrics.label: 支付订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 的订单数，包括后来全部退款的订单。

metrics.name: valid_order_count
metrics.label: 有效订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单数；取消和全退不计。

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count
metrics.label: 取消订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 cancelled 的订单数。

metrics.name: refund_order_count
metrics.label: 退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零的订单数，包括部分退款与全部退款。

metrics.name: partial_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 部分退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款大于零、小于实付金额的订单数。

metrics.name: full_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 全额退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且实付大于零、退款等于实付的订单数。

metrics.name: payment_cents
metrics.label: 实付金额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付金额合计，尚未扣退款；单位分。

metrics.name: refund_cents
metrics.label: 退款金额
metrics.description: paid 订单退款金额合计，按原订单下单日期归属，不是现金退款发生日；单位分。

metrics.name: net_sales_cents
metrics.label: 净销售额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付减退款后合计；取消单不计；按原订单下单日期归属；单位分。

metrics.name: gross_cents
metrics.label: 支付订单原价金额
metrics.description: paid 订单折扣前原价金额合计；单位分。

metrics.name: discount_cents
metrics.label: 优惠金额
metrics.description: paid 订单原价减实付的金额合计；退款不冲减原优惠金额；单位分。

metrics.name: buyer_count
metrics.label: 购买会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口及筛选条件内有有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数，不做跨系统自然人去重。

metrics.name: refund_buyer_count
metrics.label: 退款会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口内发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: selling_store_count
metrics.label: 成交门店数
metrics.description: 窗口内至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单归属门店数。

metrics.name: valid_order_items
metrics.label: 有效订单商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单中的原始购买件数合计；退款金额不能推算退货件数，此项不是净商品销量。

metrics.name: avg_order_value
metrics.label: 有效订单均额
metrics.description: 净销售额除以有效订单数，单位分／单；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: avg_buyer_value
metrics.label: 购买会员人均消费
metrics.description: 净销售额除以购买会员数，单位分／账户；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: purchase_frequency
metrics.label: 购买频次
metrics.description: 有效订单数除以购买会员数，单位单／账户；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: refund_amount_rate
metrics.label: 退款金额占比
metrics.description: 退款金额除以实付金额；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: cancel_rate
metrics.label: 取消率
metrics.description: 取消订单数除以创建订单数；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: refund_order_rate
metrics.label: 退款订单率
metrics.description: 退款订单数除以支付订单数；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: discount_rate
metrics.label: 优惠率
metrics.description: 优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: items_per_order
metrics.label: 单均商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数；分母零时未定义。
